A modern children's book illustration poster for '老虎的生日' (Tiger's Birthday). 

Main subject: An adorable cartoon tiger with a cheerful expression, wearing a colorful party hat, positioned beside a beautiful 3-tier birthday cake decorated with lit candles and frosting swirls.

Style: Contemporary flat illustration with subtle depth, clean lines, and smooth gradients. Minimalist yet playful aesthetic inspired by modern children's picture books.

Color palette: Warm coral orange and soft peach for the tiger, pastel yellow and mint green accents, cream white background with soft sky blue elements. Harmonious and gentle color scheme.

Decorative elements: Floating balloons in complementary colors (coral, yellow, mint), simple confetti dots, delicate ribbon streamers. Keep decorations minimal and elegant.

Background: Simplified forest silhouettes in muted tones, creating depth without distraction. Soft dappled lighting effect.

Composition: Tiger positioned slightly off-center with the cake, creating visual balance. Generous white space at the top for title text. Clean, uncluttered layout.

Mood: Joyful, warm, and inviting. Professional children's book quality with a contemporary touch.

Technical requirements: High contrast for readability, soft shadows for depth, rounded friendly shapes, no additional text except space for the main title.
